findings: Packed nearest bounds/topology reduce device time; indexed callbacks still use their explicit feature ranges.
FP32 error bounds certify ordinary segment cases; original FP64 predicates/rounding remain for uncertain cases.
Exact power-of-two axis factors and representable offsets permit precise FP32 division; rounding counterexamples are tested.
Conservative box interval expansion fixes a one-ULP false miss in first/any queries in 2D and 3D.
Compared with the preceding implementation, triangle closest point improves 15%; conservative triangle first/any cost 4-5%.
Nearest parity remains incomplete after competitive cuBQL leaf/block tuning. Similar traversed-node counts rule out tree work as the main 2D cause.
limits: Synthetic independent trees; timings are not a guarantee for arbitrary geometry.
